steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 20-second ad for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "20-product-parody-launch" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. 'Introducing', the product is revealed by a soft wipe from left to right on a white stage
2. the name rises in, holds, and leaves upwards; the product keeps growing slowly
3. a feature line in black and gold under the product, a little steam
4. a size counter rolls up while a gold ruler draws under the product, with a footnote
5. the camera pushes into the product and cuts to a full-screen macro close-up with two lines
6. the close-up folds into a battery icon that drains and refills, with a footnote
7. the battery is pushed out by a card with a second photo and a two-line joke
8. 'Designed in … Baked every morning.' then the product returns for the name, price and availability

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. It uses 3 photos: ask me for my own, or for permission to keep the demo images. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 20-product-parody-launch my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,7,13,19`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: To launch a different product, generate three images with the same prompts (swap the subject), keep the file names, and update IMG in the script: the pixel span of the product inside baguette.jpg (bx0, bx1) and its vertical centre (cy), so it is placed by its real width. The hero image is drawn with mix-blend-mode: multiply, so its background must be pure white. Keep the parody clearly a parody: no real company's logo, product names or claims.
